items.heading: Tigadege Na
details: Key ingredients: peanut butter, meat, tomato, chili
Brown meat pieces with onion and tomato.
Stir in peanut butter and enough water to make a sauce.
Simmer until the sauce thickens and the meat is tender.
Serve the peanut stew over rice or millet.

items.heading: Riz au Gras Malien
details: Key ingredients: rice, tomato, meat, vegetables, palm oil
Brown meat with onion in oil.
Add tomato paste and vegetables, simmering into a sauce.
Stir in rice and stock.
Cover and cook until the rice is tender and flavorful.
